source._features_note: Cargo.toml declares `default = []` — the server needs no feature flags. Explicitly NOT enabling `gpu` (pulls a GPU toolchain we cannot vendor offline) or `service_debug`/`tracing`/`tracy` (development instrumentation).
source._builder_note: tonic-build compiles the gRPC .proto files at build time and requires protoc, so protobuf-compiler must be present in the BUILD stage. edition 2024 needs rust >= 1.94; the 1.95.0 builder satisfies it. libprotobuf-dev REQUIRED alongside protobuf-compiler: prost-wkt-types build.rs imports google/protobuf/{duration,timestamp}.proto, which ship in the -dev package (well-known types), not the compiler binary.
source.source_date_epoch_provenance: the time release v1.20.2-CE-ubuntu24.04-r2 was cut (2026-11-24T17:59:51Z), by scripts/rerelease-agenda.py: ReadyStack dates an image by when its release was packaged (owner 2026-11-10), recorded here once and used by every rebuild of the release; it builds upstream commit 23065a0bf685, dated 2026-11-16T09:12:16Z (source.commit_epoch).

vendor_build._note: The dashboard. Upstream's Dockerfile runs tools/sync-web-ui.sh, which downloads the LATEST qdrant-web-ui dist-qdrant.zip unpinned and copies dist/* to /qdrant/static; v0.2.18 is the release that was latest when qdrant v1.19.1 shipped (2026-09-03 vs 2026-09-04). Pinned by sha256 in the online vendor stage, copied offline. The live r1 had no /qdrant/static and no WORKDIR, so /dashboard was 404.

binaries_from_source.name: qdrant
binaries_from_source._note: Single bin crate; Cargo.toml sets default-run = qdrant. Offline verb: cargo build --release --offline --locked.
